name: io.github.borgels/mcp-server-productive
title: Productive
description: Policy-aware MCP server for the Productive.io API: projects, tasks, time, financials and CRM.

environmentVariables.name: PRODUCTIVE_ENABLE_ADMIN
environmentVariables.description: Enable access and organization configuration tools (requires writes).

environmentVariables.name: PRODUCTIVE_ALLOWED_RESOURCES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated resource keys this instance may access.

environmentVariables.name: PRODUCTIVE_DENIED_RESOURCES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated resource keys this instance may not access.

environmentVariables.name: PRODUCTIVE_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path of the JSONL audit log.
